question: Should the protected onboarding/auth change be approved with reserved system-agent inputs allowed to rebind through their configured runtime owner while ordinary agent identities remain exact-bound?
rationale: The patch changes first-run setup and auth-runtime ownership semantics; repository policy requires explicit maintainer handling for this protected PR rather than an automated merge verdict.

options.title: Approve the bounded rebind
options.body: Accept the reserved-identity-only ownership rule after the current head’s required checks complete; this matches the focused regression coverage and real onboarding evidence.

options.title: Request additional upgrade tracing
options.body: Ask for a redacted trace covering an existing configured setup agent with stale runtime directories before accepting the auth-owner compatibility change.

options.title: Pause the ownership change
options.body: Keep the redirect and one-shot draft fixes but defer reserved runtime rebinding if maintainers do not want setup identities to resolve through configured owners.

recommendation.title: Approve the bounded rebind
recommendation.body: Accept the reserved-identity-only ownership rule after the current head’s required checks complete; this matches the focused regression coverage and real onboarding evidence.
